g.text: d Sensitivity of the extended line
Separate the spectral-method change from the sample expansion
Control gates were fixed before new Mw results: ≥30 shared Mw-A controls, |median ΔMw|≤0.05 and RMS≤0.10; populated magnitude bins also require |median|≤0.05.
Intervals resample whole families; the dotted line in (c) is the earlier 357-event slope. Design-weight sensitivities remain conditional on accepted measurements.
